transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining today's readiness huddle. As you know, we have one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic available this month, and it can operate at either the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library. Before I make the final activation decision and sign the operational plan, I need to hear from each of you on your requirements. Public health nursing, please report your clinical requirements. Pharmacy logistics, please report your supply requirements. And community outreach, please report your access requirements. Once I have all three, I'll review everything and make the site decision.

I received the updated list from the county nurse coordinator this morning.
